title: Compare edited, original and virtual-copy versions with a draggable wipe
source: rapidroom (original editor and MCP comparison workflow)
notes: Editor Compare versions overlays the current edit with its original or a pinned virtual-copy/reference preview in one shared pan/zoom surface. Drag the divider, use left/right arrows to move it, and A to swap sides. C toggles current/original comparison. The MCP reference workflow opens the same wipe and remains read-only; no recipe, sidecar, history, export or delete operation is performed.
